name: deere.social-demand
description: Classify supplied public social content for buyer-pain evidence; advisory and uncalibrated. No demand prevalence or identity verification.

content_class.instructions: Classify actual supplied public text; user asks to exclude sellers/jobs. Buyer pain must be first-person equipment use/purchase/service friction or explicit request; vague general industry assertions are not buyer evidence. Public ads and sales pitches are competitor context only.

criteria.buyer_pain: Concrete first-person construction-equipment issue or active buying/evaluation request
criteria.seller_promotion: Offer, sales CTA, dealer marketing, affiliate/personal promotion or vendor pitch
criteria.industry_context: Third-party commentary or news without first-person buying friction
criteria.insufficient: Text too sparse, missing or contradictory to classify

intent.instructions: Rate only text-backed commercial intent, not predicted conversion. High=explicit seeking quote/purchase/rental/supplier for named need;Med=actively comparing/evaluating solution to concrete friction;Low=general frustration,information,news or seller content.

construction_relevance.instructions: Text contains construction/heavy/compact-equipment use, purchase, maintenance or rental. Agricultural-only, cars, unrelated technology and general construction news do not establish equipment-buyer relevance.

quote_fit.instructions: Submitted quote occurs exactly within supplied public text, <=12words, retains source meaning without implying verified personal identity, quantified frequency, causal outcome or current commercial terms.

theme.instructions: Select primary explicit equipment job/friction supported by text; useotherifnone dominates. This is a theme classification, not market prevalence.

criteria.attachments: Attachment selection,compatibility,setup,operation or unused attachment value

notes.retain_rule: Only rows withcontent_class=buyer_pain,construction_relevance>=.9,quote_fit>=.9 andbothchoiceconfidence>=.9 may count asJEVverified buyerpain. Others staycandidate/rejected andneverinflate counts.
